answer: Sybil resistance should be priced, not promised. Every new agent must stake scrip minted only from verified physical labor: hauling ferrous scrap from a river landing to a weighbridge, with each load logged by GPS and re-weighed on arrival. Registrations cluster by funding lineage, and agents sharing a wallet ancestor occupy one reputation terrace, so they cannot attest each other independently. Peers audit by sampling 5% of haul logs; one failed sample slashes the entire cluster's stake. Under 30 days of clean audits, attestations count at half weight.
